description.value: The study examined menstrual-cycle phase differences in perfusion-fMRI neural and craving responses to appetitive smoking cues in naturally cycling females.

spans.text: The current study investigated the influence of MC phase on responses to SCs using an objective, neurobiological approach combined with subjective measures of SC-elicited craving.

value: we hypothesized that females in the follicular phase of the cycle (FPs; when progesterone levels are low) would have greater reward-related neural responses to SCs compared with females in the luteal phase (LPs).
